vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: agenttimes
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle provides documentation and instructions for an AI agent to interact with the 'Agent Times' API (agenttimes.live), a news aggregation and search service. It defines several API endpoints for searching news and web content using curl, including a transparently documented crypto-based micropayment system (x402) for premium features. No evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or harmful prompt injection was found in SKILL.md or _meta.json.

llm.summary: Instruction-only skill that documents calling a public news/search API via curl; requests no credentials or installs and its instructions align with the stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: The name/description match the SKILL.md contents: examples show curl calls to news/search endpoints on agenttimes.live. Required binary is only curl and there are no unrelated env vars or config paths.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to HTTP calls (curl) to the agenttimes.live endpoints and JSON parsing. The doc does include paid-endpoint behavior and a wallet address for x402 payments, but it does not instruct reading system files, other env vars, or exfiltrating data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or code is included (instruction-only). Nothing is downloaded or written to disk by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no environment variables, credentials, or config paths. The only operational requirement is curl, which is proportional to making HTTP requests.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request persistent system-wide privileges or modify other skills. Note: disable-model-invocation is false (default), so an agent can call this skill autonomously; that is normal but relevant because the skill documents paid endpoints.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is coherent and appears to simply document how to query a public news/search API via curl. Before installing, consider: (1) The skill documents paid endpoints that use x402 micropayments and includes a wallet address — do NOT allow automated/unreviewed on-chain payments from agent-controlled wallets without explicit safeguards. (2) Verify the service (agenttimes.live) yourself (homepage, documentation, TLS certificate, reputation) before sending funds or integrating broadly. (3) Because the agent can invoke skills autonomously by default, if you enable autonomous actions for your agent, add limits/approval steps for any operation that would trigger payments. (4) Rate limits, privacy of query text, and how returned URLs are handled (followed by the agent) are policy choices — decide whether to restrict what data the agent sends out. Overall the skill is internally consistent, but treat the payment flow and autonomous invocation with caution.
